deadline.value: January 10 priority deadline for Fall admission and funding consideration
deadline.quote: For Fall admission and funding consideration, submission prior to January 10 is strongly encouraged.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Earth Sciences subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contacting prospective faculty advisors in the program is encouraged.
supervisor.quote: The latter is often enhanced by contacting a specific prospective faculty advisors in our program.

funding.value: Applications submitted prior to January 10 considered in first rounds of departmental funding decisions.
funding.quote: Applications submitted after Jan. 10 will not be considered in the first rounds of funding decisions made by the department and may miss opportunities for university fellowships that are administered by the graduate school.
